before.rate_table_note: Rates are the single premium tables in paragraph (b)(2)(A), NONRETROACTIVE BASIS and RETROACTIVE BASIS, by number of months in which the indebtedness is repayable (6 or less, 12, 24, 36, 48, 60) and 14- or 30-day elimination period. Other premium bases and terms must be actuarially consistent ((b)(2)(B)). The Department's copy was posted April 7, 2015 on insurance.ks.gov, which now redirects to the Department's new site; the new site and the official rules site (rules.ks.gov) refuse the tool, so the 2026 text was not checked against an official copy.

source_title: K.A.R. 40-5-107, Same; credit insurance rates and forms (Kansas Insurance Department copy; effective Jan. 1, 1974; amended May 1, 1979, May 1, 1986 and May 1, 1988)
summary: Rates in force: Kansas credit accident and health single premium rate standards in K.A.R. 40-5-107(b)(2), per $100 of initial insured indebtedness, for 14- and 30-day elimination periods, nonretroactive and retroactive. The regulation was last amended effective May 1, 1988; whether that amendment changed these figures was not checked, so May 1, 1988 is the date the current text took effect.
